book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso tuŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ
Jiso ja wu tɛɛŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ bo to. Wu nya bo bvuŋga ki bo bvûuse biyo bì yiide yi bamii le bo ka fɛ̂de binchɛŋ bichii mo goŋ yichii.
Kanɛ le a jee a booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ: Wù fwe gɛ̀ bee Samoŋ wù ba ka tɛŋe lɛ Bita, bɛ Andulu wù mwa bwee. Bamu nyu Jɛm wù mwa Jɛbɛdi bɛ mwa bwee wù Joŋ,
mo Filib, Batolomiu, Toma bɛ Macho wù gɛ̀ koode ŋwa, Jɛm wù mwa Alfayu, Tadio,
bɛ Samoŋ wù gɛ̀ bee ŋgoo yi Bajalot le,
bɛ Juda Ɛkaliot wù gɛ̀ gesɛ Jiso.
Jiso tuŋ bamii ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ banɛ, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ gɛɛne, keefɛ bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ kijusɛ le njɛ le ki bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ. Keefɛ bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bilaantɛŋ bì le bi bamii ba Samaliya le gɛ.
Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ nyu fɛ booŋ ba Ishwala le ba le ba lɛsɛ wa njɛ shóŋ.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ gɛɛne bɛŋ mo bɛŋ fêeji bɛŋ dûu lɛ, ‘Bvunfoŋ bvu fɛwe le wa mbebe le.’

Bɛŋ fɛ̂de tɛ bamii ba chɛne, bɛŋ gêe bamii ba kweeyɛ wa bo tuu yu, bɛŋ fɛ̂de bamii ba kɛme goŋ yì baaŋ, bɛŋ bvûuse banchɛndaa ba debele yi bamii le. Nle nnya bvuŋga bɛŋ le achiji. Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ tɛ bɛŋ fîih bamii yu achiji.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ gɛɛne, keefɛ muh jô bige wu shûu yi kicha le gɛ, kɛnɛ nyu bì kuge, kɛnɛ nyu bì shige, kɛnɛ nyu bì shige shige nɛɛ lɛ.
Keefɛ muh jô kikɛɛ gɛ! Keefɛ muh jo bikuŋ bifɛɛ kɛnɛ jé yimi gɛ, mo nyu kimbaŋ gɛ. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ nɛ muh lɛne lɛme, tu le fo fɛ wù kɛme ki wu jîi fo.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ gɛɛŋ bɛŋ lee a laantɛŋ, kɛnɛ ntɛ le, bɛŋ gooŋ bɛŋ yɛŋ muh wù le wu kojɛ le, bena bo chêe gɛɛŋ bu kife kì bɛŋ le bɛŋ ja yo.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ gɛɛŋ, bɛŋ doo bɛŋ lese a muh yeh, bɛŋ yɛsɛ yeh yiyu le.
Yeh yiyu nɛ le yi kojɛ, kimbonɛ kena to yu yeh. Nɛ yeh yiyu baaŋ kojɛ gɛ, kimbonɛ kena kaasɛ ki tu a bɛŋ le.
Nɛ muh le wu faŋ ki wu fî bɛŋ kɛnɛ ki wu yû fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ jɛme, bɛŋ doo bɛŋ bude yeh yiyu le kɛnɛ a kilaantɛŋ kiyu le bɛŋ kaajɛ bibvunɛ biboo yi bikaa biɛna le.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ lé gê doo nyume juu chi nsa wù fɛkimɛsɛ, mwɛɛ bonɛ fɛ kilaantɛŋ ki Sodom bɛ ki Gomola le, fe kilaantɛŋ ki kɛɛ.

content: Baŋgɛ ba booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content.text: Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, ntune bɛŋ, bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ nyû njɛ shóŋ antɛnɛɛ a baŋgvufe. Noo, bɛŋ doo bɛŋ jiɛnyi bɛŋ fêefe njɛ yó, bɛŋ nyû tɛ nyiɛgee njɛ bibɛmbɛ.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ jiɛnyi bɛŋ jôde kife kune bamii. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ ba lé ba gê ba nya bɛŋ chiaaŋ yi bamii ba sage bansa le. Bo lé bo gê bo suŋe bɛŋ yéh yi buunɛ yiboo le.
Bo lé bo gê bo chii bɛŋ bo gɛɛŋ bɛ bɛŋ fwe fɛ bamii ba sage bimbe bi woŋ le, mo fwe a banfoŋ nje mɛ, wu lɛ bɛŋ mo bɛŋ jɛme bo le mo bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ kune mɛ.
Ba doo ba nya bɛŋ bo le noo, keefɛ kikwɛɛ fûuŋse bɛŋ laa bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ jɛmɛ lɛ la lɛ, je yì nɛɛ le la, nje Nyo lé wu gê wu nya fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ le bɛŋ jɛmɛ kife kiyu le.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ gɛ ka jɛme bɛŋ gɛ. Lé gê jɛ̂me Kiyo ki Chiji wene jwe wene le.
Muh lé wu gê wu ja wu jô mwa bwee wu nyâ ba yuuyɛ, chiji mwa jô mwa ye wu nyâ ba yuuyɛ. Booŋ lé bo gê bo ja bo boone bikaa a bachiji baboo jiŋ, bo gee ba yuuyi bo.
Bamii bachii lé bo gê bo banɛ bɛŋ nje jee chaŋ. Geenɛ muh wu lé wu kâaŋ shɛ́ŋ gɛɛŋ bu fɛkimɛsɛ, lé wu gê wu bonɛ.
Sege bamii booŋ bikaa a bɛŋ jiŋ a kilaantɛŋ kimi le, bɛŋ fɛ̂ɛ bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ a kimi le. Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, gɛ bɛŋ nyu bɛŋ jiɛnyɛ bilaantɛŋ bi Ishwala le bichii muh wù jee che le Mwamuh baaŋ to gɛ.
Bɛŋ kee lɛ gɛ mwa ŋwa to wu fede muh wù yɛyi wu gɛ, gɛ mwa lɛme to wù fede tɛ chiji kikwɛɛ ke gɛ.

Fi le fi kojɛ lɛ mwa ŋwa taŋlo wù nyu njɛ muh wù yɛyi wu, mwa lɛme nyu tɛ njɛ chiji kikwɛɛ ke. Ba nɛ tɛŋe chiji yeh lɛ wu le Bɛsebu, ba gɛ tɛɛŋ booŋ ba yeh bɛ jee chi kuufe ye chi fede chi chiɛɛ gɛ?
Noo, keefɛ bɛŋ fâane muh gɛ. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fì ba le ba baŋe fi nyu njɛ fi lé fi tô fi bu fɛ waaŋ sɛŋ gɛ. Gɛ fiɛɛ nyu yu tɛ fì ba nyile fì nyu njɛ ba kɛɛ sɛŋ gɛ.
Fiɛɛ fì nsɛŋe bɛŋ le antaŋ, bɛŋ lé bɛŋ jɛ̂mɛ bamii le fɛnshe. Fì nchvuune bɛŋ le, bɛŋ é bɛŋ jâŋ nyu fɛ kigo ki yeh le.
Keefɛ bɛŋ fâane bamii ba taŋlo bo yuuyɛ gɛh nyume nyaŋ yi ye maa, njɛ taŋlo bo yuuyɛ tɛ kiyo sɛŋ gɛ. Bɛŋ fâane nyu Nyo wù taŋlo wu lɛɛshɛ kiyo ki muh bɛ ye ye yi ŋgu wù baaŋ le.
Gɛ ba gese munsɛŋ munfɛɛ yi finini le maa gɛ? Geenɛ, gɛ fimimia gwee fɛkuu njɛ Chiji wene le wu bɛɛŋ sɛŋ gɛ.
Fiena le lɛ Nyo kee yvú yichii yì le a bɛŋ fwa.
Noo, keefɛ bɛŋ fâane gɛ. Bɛŋ fede munsɛŋ mù duude.
Nɛ muh bɛmɛ mɛ a bamii fwe lɛ wu kee mɛ, tu nlé ŋgê mbɛɛŋ tɛ mwɛdɛ fwe a Chijaŋ wù fɛwe.
Geenɛ le yɛɛŋ wù faŋ mɛ a bamii fwe, nlé ŋgê nfaŋ tɛ wù fwe a Chii wù fɛwe.
Keefɛ bɛŋ kwâji lɛ nto nyu bɛ nyiɛgee yi nshɛŋ le fɛnɛ gɛ. Gɛ nyu fiɛɛ fì nto nje fi gɛ. Nto nyu bɛ jɛŋ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ nto ki ŋge mwa wù jwɛŋsɛ juu bɛ chiji, mwa wù kwɛse juu bɛ bwee, kwɛ mwa juu bɛ bwe jwɛɛŋ.
Bamii ba kimbanɛ ba muh lé bo gê bo nyu bamii ba a wu yeh.
Nɛ muh koŋe chiji kɛnɛ bwee wu fede mɛ, tu wu baaŋ kojɛ gɛ ki wù nyu muh waŋ gɛ. Muh koŋe tɛ mwa ye wu jwɛŋsɛ kɛnɛ wù kwɛse wu fede mɛ, tu wu baaŋ kojɛ gɛ ki wù nyu muh waŋ gɛ.
Nɛ muh baaŋ tuu gɛ kintaaŋ ke wu bii mɛne gɛ, tu wu baaŋ kojɛ gɛ ki wù nyu muh waŋ gɛ.
Nɛ muh baji kinche ke, tu wu lé wu gê wu lɛsɛ kinche kiyu. Geenɛ muh wu lɛsɛ kinche ke nje mɛ, tu wu lé wu gê wù kɛme kinche kì kage gɛ.
Nɛ muh fii bɛŋ, tu wu fii nyu mɛ. Muh fii mɛ, tu wu fii nyume muh wu tuŋ mɛ.

Nɛ muh fii muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo nje wu kee lɛ le Nyo wù tuŋ wu, tu wu lé wu gê wù kɛme maajɛ wù Nyo maaji bamii be ba ntuŋ yu. Nɛ muh fii muh wù chaaŋ nje wu kee lɛ mwɛdɛ le muh wù chaaŋ, tu wu lé wu gê wù kɛme maajɛ wù Nyo maaji bamii ba chaaŋ yu.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, muh wù nya fiŋkoo fi joo yi jiɛɛ muh wu mumwaa a ŋgoo yi bamii ba shige shige banɛ le nje wu kee lɛ le muh waŋ wu ŋgoo, tu gɛ mwɛdɛ nyu wu to wu fu maajɛ we gɛ.”

footnotes.text: Bajalot gɛ̀ bee Bajuu ba gɛ̀ toone woŋ, bo juu ki bo bvusɛ bo yi ŋgɛ le chiaaŋ yi bamii ba Lum le.
